query: INSERT INTO photos(id,short_id,album_id,title,description,taken_at,posted_at,sort_order,visibility,original_hash,original_name,original_bytes,mime,kind,width,height,orientation,is_hdr,has_gain_map,icc_name,camera_make,camera_model,lens,focal_mm,aperture,shutter,iso,gps_lat,gps_lon,place_id,dominant_colors,placeholder,status,failure_reason,derivative_plan,taken_at_local,original_orientation,generation,taken_at_override,gps_overridden,place_overridden) SELECT m.target,m.short,$4,p.title,p.description,p.taken_at,p.posted_at,p.sort_order,p.visibility,p.original_hash,p.original_name,p.original_bytes,p.mime,p.kind,p.width,p.height,p.orientation,p.is_hdr,p.has_gain_map,p.icc_name,p.camera_make,p.camera_model,p.lens,p.focal_mm,p.aperture,p.shutter,p.iso,p.gps_lat,p.gps_lon,p.place_id,p.dominant_colors,p.placeholder,p.status,p.failure_reason,p.derivative_plan,p.taken_at_local,p.original_orientation,p.generation,p.taken_at_override,p.gps_overridden,p.place_overridden FROM photos p JOIN unnest($1::uuid[],$2::uuid[],$3::text[]) m(source,target,short) ON p.id=m.source
